sentences.en: So it's a kind of insane level of micromanaging.
sentences.zh: 这种微观管理的程度简直丧心病狂。

sentences.en: And there is no way that Cardigan can put up with this for more than a couple of days and not go completely mad.
sentences.zh: 卡迪根绝对无法忍受这种日子超过两天而不发疯。

sentences.en: So that's another reason why he wants to get out of Scutari.
sentences.zh: 所以这也是他想离开斯库塔里的另一个原因。

sentences.en: But I think probably the main reason is that he wants to have a crack at the Russians.
sentences.zh: 但我想主要原因大概还是他想去跟俄国人过过招。

sentences.en: He wants to see active service.
sentences.zh: 他渴望上前线服现役。

sentences.en: And he's not going to get that at the Bosphorus because things have been moving while Cardigan has been dining at the Café de Paris.
sentences.zh: 而在博斯普鲁斯海峡他实现不了这个愿望，因为当卡迪根在巴黎咖啡馆享用晚餐时，局势已经在发展了。

sentences.en: So let's give people a sense of the sort of strategic geography.
sentences.zh: 那么让我们向听众大致介绍一下战略地理形势。

sentences.en: So you've got Constantinople, which commands the Bosphorus, which links Europe and Asia.
sentences.zh: 首先是君士坦丁堡，它控制着连接欧洲和亚洲的博斯普鲁斯海峡。

sentences.en: Above that, you've got the Black Sea.
sentences.zh: 再往上是黑海。

sentences.en: And then above that, obviously, the Russian Empire.
sentences.zh: 然后显而易见，再往上就是俄罗斯帝国。

sentences.en: So Crimea jutting out into the Black Sea.
sentences.zh: 克里米亚半岛则凸入黑海。

sentences.en: And what the Allies are worried about, aren't they, are the Russians taking Constantinople.
sentences.zh: 盟军最担心的是俄国人占领君士坦丁堡，对吧？

sentences.en: But if the Russians took Constantinople, you know, they would command the hinge between Europe and Asia.
sentences.zh: 但如果俄国人占领了君士坦丁堡，他们就将掌控欧洲和亚洲之间的枢纽。

sentences.en: They would command the traffic between the Black Sea and the Mediterranean.
sentences.zh: 他们将控制黑海和地中海之间的航运。

sentences.en: The Russians must never, ever be allowed to get it.
sentences.zh: 绝不能、绝对不能让俄国人得逞。

sentences.en: And that's why the British are in Scutari on the other side of the Bosphorus from Constantinople.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么英国人驻扎在博斯普鲁斯海峡对岸、与君士坦丁堡隔海相望的斯库塔里。

sentences.en: And the French are just further down the coast at a peninsula called Gallipoli.
sentences.zh: 而法国人则在海岸更下方的加里波利半岛。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I think just to emphasize that it's the weakness of the Turks that makes the British and the French their allies because they don't have to fear the Turks.
sentences.zh: 我想强调的是，正因为土耳其人的软弱，才使得英法两国将其视作盟友，因为他们无需畏惧土耳其人。

sentences.en: So they'd rather have someone weak in Constantinople than someone aggressive like the Tsar.
sentences.zh: 所以他们宁愿君士坦丁堡有一个软弱的政权，也不愿看到沙皇这样咄咄逼人的对手。

sentences.en: So that's the point.
sentences.zh: 这就是关键所在。

sentences.en: Now, the Tsar, obviously, he wants to get Constantinople.
sentences.zh: 现在，沙皇显然一心想要夺取君士坦丁堡。

sentences.en: That's his dream.
sentences.zh: 那是他的梦想。

sentences.en: He wants to take possession of the great city of Constantine and reclaim it for the Orthodox Christian faith.
sentences.zh: 他想要占领君士坦丁这座伟大的城市，并为东正教信仰将其收复。

sentences.en: He wants to see Hagia Sophia once again proclaimed as a great cathedral.
sentences.zh: 他希望看到圣索菲亚大教堂再次被宣布为一座宏伟的主教座堂。

sentences.en: And so with this objective in mind, in the summer of 1853, the Russians had crossed the border into the Ottoman Empire and occupied its two most northerly provinces,
sentences.zh: 带着这个目标，在1853年夏天，俄军越过边界进入奥斯曼帝国，占领了其最北部的两个省份，

sentences.en: the principalities of Moldova and Wallachia, so the future Romania.
sentences.zh: 即摩尔多瓦和瓦拉几亚公国，也就是未来的罗马尼亚。

sentences.en: And these lie north of the great river Danube.
sentences.zh: 这些地方位于多瑙河大河以北。

sentences.en: The Tsar's plan was to use these as a launch pad for an advance on Constantinople.
sentences.zh: 沙皇的计划是以此为跳板，向君士坦丁堡发起进攻。

sentences.en: And sure enough, in the spring of 1854, so this is as the British and French are preparing for war and Lord Cardigan is settling down to dine at the Café de Paris,
sentences.zh: 果然，在1854年春天，也就是英法两国正为战争做准备、卡迪根勋爵在巴黎咖啡馆安顿下来享用晚宴的同时，

sentences.en: the Russian advance southwards begins.
sentences.zh: 俄军向南推进的步伐开始了。

sentences.en: And ahead of them, as we have said, lies the Danube, particularly the lower reaches of the Danube, across which the Russians have to cross,
sentences.zh: 正如我们所说，横亘在他们面前的是多瑙河，特别是多瑙河下游，俄军必须渡过这些被瘟疫横行的沼泽包围的河段。

sentences.en: are surrounded by pestiferous marshlands.
sentences.zh: 因此，正如俄军推进到瘟疫沼泽时的常态一样，他们开始遭受饥饿和疾病的折磨。

sentences.en: And so as always happens when a Russian army advances into a pestiferous marshland, they start succumbing to hunger and disease.
sentences.zh: 那里没有食物，有着成群结队的蚊子，痢疾也非常盛行。

sentences.en: There's nothing to eat and there are enormous swarms of mosquitoes and dysentery is highly prevalent.
sentences.zh: 因此，甚至在他们抵达目标——位于多瑙河西岸、地处河道弯曲处名为锡利斯特里的宏伟大要塞之前，

sentences.en: So even before they reach their target, which is a great fortress on the south bank of the Danube, situated on a curve in the river called Silistria,
sentences.zh: 他们的兵力就已经开始严重消耗了。

sentences.en: their numbers are becoming depleted.
sentences.zh: 他们在锡利斯特里阵前驻扎下来，渡过多瑙河并准备发起强攻。

sentences.en: And they settle down in front of Silistria, they cross the Danube and get ready to storm it.
sentences.zh: 在攻克它之前，他们实在无法继续向前推进。

sentences.en: They can't really move forward until they've taken it.
sentences.zh: 围城战于5月11日打响，当时英国和法国的第一批运兵船刚刚抵达加里波利外海。

sentences.en: And the siege begins on the 11th of May, even as the first British and French transport ships are arriving off Gallipoli.
sentences.zh: 因此俄军最高指挥部深知，这是一场与时间的赛跑，既要对抗正在大肆摧毁其军队的瘟疫，

sentences.en: And so the Russian high command know that it's a race against time, against disease, which is decimating their troop, their army,
sentences.zh: 也要抢在英法增援部队抵达并巩固土耳其防线之前分出胜负。

sentences.en: but also against the prospect of the British and the French reinforcements arriving and buttressing the Turkish defence.
sentences.zh: 所以他们必须尽快攻克锡利斯特里，否则整个进军计划都将宣告破产。

sentences.en: So they've got to capture Silistria as soon as possible, because otherwise the whole advance will be doomed.
sentences.zh: 必须指出的是，尽管军队饱受疾病和饥饿的折磨，俄军最高指挥部对胜利依然充满信心。

sentences.en: And it has to be said that despite the kind of the disease and the hunger afflicting their army, the Russian high command are confident of victory.
sentences.zh: 尽管军队饱受疾病和饥饿的折磨，俄军最高指挥部对胜利依然充满信心。

sentences.en: So they had, they've started off with 100,000 men.
sentences.zh: 所以他们当时出动了十万大军。

sentences.en: So even if they lose 10,000 men to disease, you know, they've still got 90,000.
sentences.zh: 因此，即使他们因疾病损失了一万人，你知道，他们依然还有九万人。

sentences.en: And among these men is a young lieutenant named Count Leo Tolstoy, who will also in due course fight at Crimea.
sentences.zh: 这些士兵中有一位名叫列夫·托尔斯泰伯爵的年轻中尉，他日后也将在克里米亚参战。

sentences.en: And his experience of these battles and wars are what is going to inform his portrayal of Napoleon's invasion in war and peace.
sentences.zh: 他对这些战役和战争的亲身经历，将为他在《战争与和平》中对拿破仑入侵的描绘提供素材。

sentences.en: So why are the Russians confident?
sentences.zh: 那么，俄国人为什么如此自信呢？

sentences.en: Basically, they're confident because they always beat the Turks.
sentences.zh: 基本上，他们自信是因为他们总是能打败土耳其人。

sentences.en: They think the Turks are useless.
sentences.zh: 他们认为土耳其人毫无用处。

sentences.en: And Silistria only has at most 18,000 defenders.
sentences.zh: 而且锡利斯特里亚最多只有一万八千名守军。

sentences.en: And these consist of Turks and Egyptians.
sentences.zh: 这些守军由土耳其人和埃及人组成。

sentences.en: And the Russians just despise the Turks and the Egyptians.
sentences.zh: 而俄国人对土耳其人和埃及人充满了鄙视。

sentences.en: They think, you know, we can easily defeat them.
sentences.zh: 他们心想，你知道的，我们可以轻易击败他们。

sentences.en: However, they are going to be proven overconfident.
sentences.zh: 然而，事实证明他们过于自信了。

sentences.en: Because to the consternation of the Russians, the Turks and Egyptians put up an absolutely ferocious resistance.
sentences.zh: 因为令俄国人震惊的是，土耳其人和埃及人进行了极其顽强的抵抗。

sentences.en: And their commander, who's a tremendous chap called Musa Pasha, summons them to defend Silistria as becomes the descendants of the prophet.
sentences.zh: 他们的指挥官是一位名叫穆萨帕夏的了不起的人物，他号召大家像先知的后代一样保卫锡利斯特里亚。

sentences.en: And they fight with an almost religious zeal and with great ferocity.
sentences.zh: 他们带着近乎宗教般的狂热和巨大的凶猛投入战斗。

sentences.en: So great piles of Russian heads start to appear by the gates of Silistria, you know, harvested from the Russian dead.
sentences.zh: 于是，锡利斯特里亚的城门外开始出现一堆堆俄罗斯人的头颅，你知道，都是从战死的俄军身上割下来的。

sentences.en: And there's a British officer who's in command of the key Turkish artillery poSt.
sentences.zh: 有一名英国军官指挥着土耳其人的关键炮兵阵地。

sentences.en: He's been there several years and has been responsible for training the Turkish artillery.
sentences.zh: 他在那里待了好几年，一直负责训练土耳其炮兵。

sentences.en: He hangs out with Musa Pasha quite a lot.
sentences.zh: 他经常和穆萨帕夏混在一起。

sentences.en: And he records sitting with Musa Pasha when a ruffian came out and threw at his feet a pair of ears, which he had cut from a Russian soldier.
sentences.zh: 他记录道，有一次他和穆萨帕夏坐在一起，一个恶棍走过来，把一双从一个俄国士兵身上割下来的耳朵扔在他脚下。

sentences.en: Another boasted to us that a Russian officer had begged him for mercy in the name of the prophet, but that he had drawn his knife and in cold blood had cut his throat.
sentences.zh: 另一个人向我们吹嘘说，一个俄国军官曾奉先知的名义向他乞求饶命，但他却拔出刀，冷血地割断了对方的喉咙。

sentences.en: So the siege is pretty brutal.
sentences.zh: 所以这场围城战相当残酷。

sentences.en: And the Turks are definitely giving as good as they get.
sentences.zh: 而且土耳其人绝对是毫不逊色、针锋相对。

sentences.en: But that doesn't mean that they, you know, they're not desperate to see the allies move from their base around Constantinople.
sentences.zh: 但这并不意味着他们，你知道的，不渴望看到盟军从君士坦丁堡周边的基地转移出来。

sentences.en: They want the allies to come to their defense.
sentences.zh: 他们希望盟军能来支援他们。

sentences.en: And so they're saying, yeah, you know, don't hang out in Gallipoli, don't hang out in Scutari, come north.
sentences.zh: 所以他们在说，行吧，你知道的，别在加里波利闲晃了，别在斯库塔里闲晃了，往北走吧。

sentences.en: And the man who is particularly pushing Raglan and Saint-Arnaud, the French commander, to do this is the Ottoman commander in Ramelli, as it's called,
sentences.zh: 而那个极力敦促拉格兰和法国指挥官圣阿尔诺这么做的人，是奥斯曼在拉梅利（正如其名）的指挥官，

sentences.en: the European part of the Ottoman Empire.
sentences.zh: 也就是奥斯曼帝国的欧洲部分。

sentences.en: And this is a remarkable character called Omar Pasha.
sentences.zh: 这是一个了不起的人物，名叫奥马尔帕夏。

sentences.en: So he's a Croat and had actually been baptized a Christian and had gone on to serve in the Austrian army.
sentences.zh: 他是一个克罗地亚人，实际上曾受洗为基督徒，后来还在奥地利军队中服役过。

sentences.en: But he'd then been accused of embezzlement and had fled to Ottoman Bosnia.
sentences.zh: 但他后来被指控贪污，于是逃到了奥斯曼波斯尼亚。

sentences.en: And he'd ended up in Constantinople and he'd realized that the way to get ahead was to convert to Islam.
sentences.zh: 他最终来到了君士坦丁堡，并意识到要想飞黄腾达，唯一的办法就是皈依伊斯兰教。

sentences.en: And so he does that.
sentences.zh: 于是他照做了。

sentences.en: And he ends up, as we said, the commander of the Ottoman forces in Ramelli.
sentences.zh: 正如我们所说，他最终成为了奥斯曼军队在拉梅利的指挥官。

sentences.en: And he's very jolly, very chatty, and he loves his life as a wealthy Pasha.
sentences.zh: 他非常快活，健谈，并且很享受自己作为富有帕夏的生活。

sentences.en: It's obviously much better than being a sergeant in the Austrian army or whatever.
sentences.zh: 这显然比当奥地利军队的军士或干别的什么要好得多。

sentences.en: So Orlando Fijis, in his book on the Crimean War, describes him as a man dressed in a uniform decorated with gold braid and precious stones.
sentences.zh: 因此，奥兰多·费吉斯在他关于克里米亚战争的书中将他描述为一个身穿饰有金线和宝石制服的人。

sentences.en: He kept a private harem and employed an orchestra of Germans to accompany his troops.
sentences.zh: 他保留了私人的后宫，并雇佣了一支德国乐队来随行伴奏。

sentences.en: He sounds like he's having a great time.
sentences.zh: 听起来他过得很开心。

sentences.en: So he's absolutely living his best life.
sentences.zh: 所以他真的是在过着最精彩的生活。

sentences.en: He really is.
sentences.zh: 他确实如此。

sentences.en: And so he is trying to work his magic on the French and British commanders.
sentences.zh: 因此，他正试图对法军和英军指挥官施展他的魅力攻势。

sentences.en: And Santin, though, he's not really very keen.
sentences.zh: 不过圣阿尔诺对此其实并不怎么热心。

sentences.en: He's happier hanging out in Gallipoli.
sentences.zh: 他更愿意在加里波利闲晃。

sentences.en: That was kind of wheeling and dealing and engaging in scaMs.
sentences.zh: 那家伙整天搞些投机倒把和骗局。

sentences.en: But Raglan, he's much more accommodating.
sentences.zh: 但拉格兰要随和得多。

sentences.en: He's a gentleman.
sentences.zh: 他是个绅士。

sentences.en: I don't know if this is what our host wants, then we must do as requested.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这是否是我们的主人想要的，如果是，那我们就必须按要求行事。

sentences.en: And so already, by the time that Cardigan arrives in Scutari, it's clear that its days as the main active British base are numbered,
sentences.zh: 因此，当卡迪根抵达斯库塔里时，很明显它作为英国主要现役基地的日子已经屈指可数了，

sentences.en: that the British are definitely going to be moving northwards up the Black Sea coaSt.
sentences.zh: 英国人肯定会沿黑海海岸向北移动。

sentences.en: And specifically to a place called Varna, which is a very small picturesque port in Bulgaria, some hundred miles south of Silistria.
sentences.zh: 具体来说是一个叫瓦尔纳的地方，那是保加利亚一个非常小而风景如画的港口，在锡利斯特里亚以南约一百英里处。

sentences.en: And I know about Varna because Simon, my beloved Bulgarian personal trainer, to whom I owe so much.
sentences.zh: 我知道瓦尔纳，因为西蒙，我深爱的保加利亚私人教练，我太感激他了。

sentences.en: Is he from Varna?
sentences.zh: 他是瓦尔纳人吗？

sentences.en: His wife Mina is from Varna and they love it.
sentences.zh: 他的妻子米娜是瓦尔纳人，他们非常喜欢那里。

sentences.en: And they're always going there.
sentences.zh: 他们经常去那里。

sentences.en: They've got a little house there and they go to the beach and everything.
sentences.zh: 他们在那里有一栋小房子，去海滩以及干各种事情。

sentences.en: I've been to Varna.
sentences.zh: 我去过瓦尔纳。

sentences.en: Did you like it?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢那里吗？

sentences.en: It's very nice.
sentences.zh: 非常不错。

sentences.en: I think Varna, I seem to remember an aquarium.
sentences.zh: 我想瓦尔纳，我好像记得有一个水族馆。

sentences.en: You can go down to this beautiful kind of Byzantine kind of Black Sea resort.
sentences.zh: 你可以去那种美丽的拜占庭式的黑海度假胜地。

sentences.en: It's actually lovely.
sentences.zh: 其实挺不错的。

sentences.en: It's a Bulgarian coaSt.
sentences.zh: 那是保加利亚的海岸。

sentences.en: I recommend it.
sentences.zh: 我向你推荐。

sentences.en: The Bulgarian tourist board, by the way, should be sponsoring this episode.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，保加利亚旅游局应该赞助这一集。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so it's to Varna that the ships carrying the cavalry, as they start arriving, are directed.
sentences.zh: 因此，运送骑兵的船只在陆续抵达时，都被指挥驶往瓦尔纳。

sentences.en: And Cardigan, four days after he's arrived in Scutari, thinks, OK, well, I'm going to, you know, if that's where the cavalry are going, I'm going to go with them.
sentences.zh: 卡迪根在抵达斯库塔里四天后心想，好吧，如果那是骑兵要去的地方，那我也要和他们一起去。

sentences.en: And so he takes ship and his permission to do this has come directly from Lord Raglan, his family friend.
sentences.zh: 于是他登船出发，他获得此行的许可直接来自于他的家族朋友拉格兰勋爵。

sentences.en: And the point of this is that contrary to all military regulations, he has not applied for permission to head to Varna from Scutari from his immediate commanding officer,
sentences.zh: 关键在于，违反所有军事条例的是，他并没有向他的直接指挥官申请从斯库塔里前往瓦尔纳的许可，

sentences.en: Lord Lucan, but has gone over Lord Lucan's head.
sentences.zh: 也就是卢卡恩勋爵，而是越过了卢卡恩勋爵直接去办了。

sentences.en: Oh, so he's cut Lucan out of the equation.
sentences.zh: 哦，所以他把卢卡恩排除在外了。

sentences.en: He's cut Lucan out of the equation, has gone to Waglan.
sentences.zh: 他把卢卡恩排除在外，直接去找了拉格兰。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And Lucan, presumably, is not happy.
sentences.zh: 而卢卡恩想必很不高兴。

sentences.en: He is furious.
sentences.zh: 他气坏了。

sentences.en: I mean, he thinks Cardigan's been insubordinate.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他认为卡迪根目无军纪。

sentences.en: What else would he expect?
sentences.zh: 他还能指望什么呢？

sentences.en: But he's very indignant and upset that Raglan hasn't backed him.
sentences.zh: 但他感到非常愤怒和沮丧，因为拉格兰没有支持他。

sentences.en: And he's humiliated that the British cavalry, of which he is the commander, are now all in Varna.
sentences.zh: 而且他感到羞辱的是，由他指挥的英国骑兵现在全都在瓦尔纳。

sentences.en: And he's stuck in Scutari, kind of worrying about washerwomen doing their washing next to fountains and things.
sentences.zh: 而他却被困在斯库塔里，整天担心洗衣妇在喷泉旁边洗衣服之类的事情。

sentences.en: But he, you know, he's a man who does his duty and he feels that, you know, he's been commanded with making sure that Scutari is ship shape and it's very smelly and run down.
sentences.zh: 但他，你知道的，他是一个尽职尽责的人，他觉得自己被委任确保斯库塔里整洁有序，虽然那里气味难闻且破败不堪。

sentences.en: So he wants to make it ready to receive further British reinforcements.
sentences.zh: 所以他想把它准备好，以迎接更多的英国增援部队。

sentences.en: And he does that.
sentences.zh: 他也确实这么做了。

sentences.en: And it's not until the 15th of June that he finally arrives in Varna.
sentences.zh: 直到6月15日，他才最终抵达瓦尔纳。

sentences.en: And when he gets to Varna, he is appalled to discover that there is no trace of Cardigan at all and that most of the cavalry seem to have vanished into thin air.
sentences.zh: 当他到达瓦尔纳时，震惊地发现根本找不到卡迪根的踪迹，而且大部分骑兵似乎都凭空消失了。

sentences.en: And as a result, there's very little for Lucan to do.
sentences.zh: 结果，卢卡恩无事可做。

sentences.en: And so he contents himself with firing off complaints to Raglan, saying Cardigan's behaved appallingly.
sentences.zh: 于是他只能通过向拉格兰发泄抱怨来聊以自慰，说卡迪根表现得糟透了。

sentences.en: I hate him.
sentences.zh: 我恨他。

sentences.en: Get rid of him.
sentences.zh: 把他赶走。

sentences.en: Whatever.
sentences.zh: 随便怎样。

sentences.en: It's not fair.
sentences.zh: 这不公平。

sentences.en: And drilling such members of the cavalry as are present in Varna kind of relentlessly.
sentences.zh: 并且无休止地操练那些在瓦尔纳的骑兵成员。

sentences.en: But even this goes wrong because Lucan hasn't drilled cavalry for years and all the words of command have changed.
sentences.zh: 但即使是这也出了问题，因为卢卡恩已经多年没有操练过骑兵了，所有的口令都变了。

sentences.en: And predictably, rather than learning the new drills, Lucan requires the cavalry to learn all the old drills.
sentences.zh: 不出所料，卢卡恩没有去学习新的操练方法，而是要求骑兵学习所有旧的操练方法。

sentences.en: And the result is complete chaos.
sentences.zh: 结果就是一片混乱。

sentences.en: They keep marching into each other and turning left and going into trees and things.
sentences.zh: 他们不断撞到对方，向左转然后撞进树里之类的事情。

sentences.en: And one hostile observer, someone who despises Lucan, observes,
sentences.zh: 一个心怀敌意的观察者，一个鄙视卢卡恩的人评论道，

sentences.en: it was as if one of the cavalry commanders of the Thirty Years' War had risen from his grave to take command after the fashion of the day.
sentences.zh: 这就像三十年战争中的某个骑兵指挥官从坟墓里爬出来，按照当时的时尚接管指挥一样。

sentences.en: Oh, my word.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Okay, well, that doesn't bode well.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这可不是什么好兆头。

sentences.en: Now, while Lucan is drilling them in the fashions of the Thirty Years' War, where are Cardigan and the Light Brigade and all this?
sentences.zh: 现在，当卢卡恩以三十年战争的风范操练他们时，卡迪根、轻骑兵旅以及这些人都去哪儿了呢？

sentences.en: So where have they gone to, first of all?
sentences.zh: 那么，首先他们去哪儿了？

sentences.en: Cardigan has evacuated them from Varna to a delightful spot called Devna, which Woodham Smith in her book describes as a beautiful valley like an English park with trees, streams,
sentences.zh: 卡迪根将他们从瓦尔纳撤离到一个叫做德夫纳的迷人地方，伍德姆·史密斯在书中将其描述为一个美丽的峡谷，就像一个拥有树木、溪流的英国公园，

sentences.en: banks of wildflowers, and a profusion of wild grapes.
sentences.zh: 岸边开满了野花，还有大量的野生葡萄。

sentences.en: And actually, Cardigan amazingly has been very sensible here because we said what a picturesque, charming spot Varna is.
sentences.zh: 事实上，卡迪根在这里表现得非常明智，因为我们说过瓦尔纳曾经是一个多么风景如画、迷人的地方。

sentences.en: It is no longer a picturesque and charming spot after huge shiploads carrying British and French soldiers have arrived there because these soldiers start putting an impossible strain on Varna's single drain.
sentences.zh: 在大量载有英法士兵的船只抵达后，它就不再是一个风景如画、迷人的地方了，因为这些士兵开始给瓦尔纳唯一的一条下水道造成无法承受的压力。

sentences.en: Okay, are we in the world of dysentery?
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们这是进入了痢疾的世界了吗？

sentences.en: Our old friend dysentery joining us on the show.
sentences.zh: 我们的老朋友痢疾也加入了我们的节目。

sentences.en: So great to have dysentery back on the show.
sentences.zh: 很高兴痢疾再次回到节目中。

sentences.en: Dysentery is very soon raging in Varna.
sentences.zh: 痢疾很快在瓦尔纳肆虐开来。

sentences.en: So it's the kind of worst kind of tourist to arrive.
sentences.zh: 所以这是那种最糟糕的游客到来。

sentences.en: Hundreds, you know, thousands, tens of thousands of British and French soldiers.
sentences.zh: 成百上千，你知道的，成千上万，数以万计的英法士兵。

sentences.en: And not just dysentery, but cholera, right?
sentences.zh: 不仅是痢疾，还有霍乱，对吧？

sentences.en: Cholera, cholera as well.
sentences.zh: 霍乱，还有霍乱。

sentences.en: So cholera appears first in the French camp, then in the British camp.
sentences.zh: 于是霍乱先在法军营地出现，然后又在英军营地出现。

sentences.en: There's a hot wind blowing in from across the Balkans and it covers everyone in Varna, we're told, in white dust and dead flies.
sentences.zh: 一阵热风从巴尔干半岛吹来，据我们所知，它把瓦尔纳的每个人都覆盖在白色的灰尘和死苍蝇中。

sentences.en: It's a horrible detail.
sentences.zh: 这是一个可怕的细节。

sentences.en: And soon thousands of British and French soldiers are dying.
sentences.zh: 很快，成千上万的英法士兵相继死去。

sentences.en: And the dead have to be wrapped up in blankets and buried in a mass grave.
sentences.zh: 死者不得不被毯子裹起来，埋在万人坑里。

sentences.en: And even the mass grave is then dug up by the locals who want the blankets for themselves.
sentences.zh: 甚至连万人坑后来也被当地人挖开，因为他们想要那些毯子留给自己。

sentences.en: So it's a hideous, hideous scene.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个极其恐怖的场景。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, up in Devna, Cardigan is relaxing in his farmhouse and dwelling his men.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，在北部的德夫纳，卡迪根正在他的农舍里放松并操练他的手下。

sentences.en: He's had a slight chest infection, so he's recovering from that.
sentences.zh: 他有点轻微的胸部感染，所以正在康复中。

sentences.en: But he's, you know, he's gearing up to have a quack at the Russians.
sentences.zh: 但他，你知道的，他正准备去和俄国人干一仗。

sentences.en: Very excited about this.
sentences.zh: 对此感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: This is what he's come for.
sentences.zh: 这就是他来这里的目的。

sentences.en: This is what everyone is looking forward to.
sentences.zh: 这也是每个人都在期待的。

sentences.en: You know, this is the sport that they've been looking forward to.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这就是他们一直期待的运动。

sentences.en: But then, Dominic, on the 25th of June, devastating news.
sentences.zh: 但是接着，多米尼克，6月25日，传来了毁灭性的消息。

sentences.en: The Russians have raised the siege of Silistria.
sentences.zh: 俄国人解除对锡利斯特里亚的围困了。

sentences.en: Well, they've given up.
sentences.zh: 好吧，他们放弃了。

sentences.en: They've given up.
sentences.zh: 他们放弃了。

sentences.en: I mean, obviously, on one level, this isn't devastating at all.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，从某种程度上讲，这显然根本不是什么毁灭性的消息。

sentences.en: This is what, this is great news.
sentences.zh: 这是什么，这是个好消息。

sentences.en: You know, the British and French have come here to ward the Russians off.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，英法联军来这里就是为了击退俄国人。

sentences.en: And now they've gone back.
sentences.zh: 现在他们撤退了。

sentences.en: So basically, they've won.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，他们赢了。

sentences.en: But on another level, for someone like Cardigan, for someone like his men, it's devastating.
sentences.zh: 但从另一方面来看，对于像卡迪根这样的人，对于像他的手下这样的人来说，这就是毁灭性的。

sentences.en: Because they want, you know, they've come here to fight.
sentences.zh: 因为他们想要，你知道的，他们是来打仗的。

sentences.en: And now it looks like they're going to be denied it.
sentences.zh: 而现在看来他们的愿望要落空了。

sentences.en: So Raglan, I think, also shares a sense of disappointment.
sentences.zh: 所以我想拉格兰也有一种失望的感觉。

sentences.en: And he orders Cardigan to make a reconnaissance, to head north and discover.
sentences.zh: 他命令卡迪根进行一次侦察，向北推进并探明情况。

sentences.en: And I quote Raglan's orders.
sentences.zh: 我引用拉格兰的命令。

sentences.en: If the Russian army was still on this side of the Danube, and Cardigan couldn't be happier.
sentences.zh: 如果俄军仍然在多瑙河这一侧，卡迪根会高兴极了。

sentences.en: You know, this is his chance.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这是他的机会。

sentences.en: At last, he's been, you know, he's been given orders to go and possibly have a crack at the Russians.
sentences.zh: 终于，他得到了命令去前去寻找机会和俄国人较量一番。

sentences.en: So he leaves at the head of 121 troopers.
sentences.zh: 于是他率领着121名骑兵出发了。

sentences.en: And by the 29th of June, they have reached the Danube.
sentences.zh: 到6月29日，他们已经抵达多瑙河畔。

sentences.en: And they are able to confirm that, yes, the Russians have withdrawn, that they have gone back across the river and they have pulled out from the region altogether.
sentences.zh: 他们得以证实，是的，俄国人已经撤退了，他们已经退回了河对岸，并且彻底撤出了该地区。

sentences.en: And when Cardigan returns with this report, he's immensely pleased with himself.
sentences.zh: 当卡迪根带着这份报告返回时，他对自己满意得不得了。

sentences.en: And he boasts about it to his peers that he had actually slept in a tent.
sentences.zh: 他在同僚面前大肆吹嘘，说自己居然真的睡在帐篷里。

sentences.en: And he'd eaten almost the same food as his men.
sentences.zh: 而且他吃的食物和手下的士兵几乎一模一样。

sentences.en: And only once over the entire 17-day course of his mission had he changed his clothes.
sentences.zh: 在他整个长达17天的任务期间，他竟然只换过一次衣服。

sentences.en: So he'd really been waffling it, like the men.
sentences.zh: 所以他真的吃了不少苦，和普通士兵一样。

sentences.en: And Raglan is so impressed by this that on the 20th of July, he promotes Cardigan to Major General.
sentences.zh: 拉格兰对此印象深刻，于是在7月20日晋升卡迪根为少将。

sentences.en: So, huzzah, Cardigan has covered himself in glory.
sentences.zh: 所以，好啊，卡迪根可谓满载荣誉。

sentences.en: Or, Dominic, has he?
sentences.zh: 或者说，多米尼克，真的是这样吗？

sentences.en: Has Cardigan really proven himself a military genius?
sentences.zh: 卡迪根真的证明自己是个军事天才了吗？

sentences.en: What, are you telling me that this reconnaissance expedition to the Danube didn't go quite as well as Cardigan is making out?
sentences.zh: 怎么，你是想告诉我，这次多瑙河侦察行动并没有像卡迪根所说的那样顺利吗？

sentences.en: I can't believe that.
sentences.zh: 我简直不敢相信。

sentences.en: I fear so.
sentences.zh: 恐怕是的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: So the reconnaissance of the Danube had actually been incredibly brutal.
sentences.zh: 所以多瑙河的侦察行动实际上残酷得难以置信。

sentences.en: Cardigan had massively exceeded his orders.
sentences.zh: 卡迪根大大超出了他的命令范围。

sentences.en: He'd got to the Danube and then he'd gone gallivanting all over the place.
sentences.zh: 他到了多瑙河，然后就在各处到处闲逛。

sentences.en: Very like Custer, actually.
sentences.zh: 这其实非常像卡斯特。

sentences.en: There's something of Custer about Cardigan.
sentences.zh: 卡迪根身上确实有点卡斯特的影子。

sentences.en: And Cardigan obviously had no maps.
sentences.zh: 而且卡迪根显然没有地图。

sentences.en: He had no local knowledge.
sentences.zh: 他对当地一无所知。

sentences.en: He didn't know anything about it.
sentences.zh: 他对情况毫无了解。

sentences.en: And so they'd headed off into places where there was no water, no food or anything.
sentences.zh: 因此他们一头扎进了没有水、没有食物或任何东西的地方。

sentences.en: And on their return to Devna, you know, his reconnaissance troop presented a really shocking sight.
sentences.zh: 当他们返回瓦尔纳时，你知道，他的侦察部队呈现出一种令人震惊的景象。

sentences.en: So they would describe, you know, men on foot driving and goading on their wretched, wretched horses, three or four of which could hardly stir.
sentences.zh: 他们描述说，士兵们步行驱赶并鞭策着他们可怜得不行的马匹，其中三四匹几乎都走不动了。

sentences.en: Actually, this reconnaissance mission ends up putting about 100 horses out of action.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这次侦察任务最终导致大约100匹马失去了行动能力。

sentences.en: And his critics refer to it as the sawback reconnaissance.
sentences.zh: 他的批评者称之为锯背侦察。

sentences.en: And it's actually a bit of a disaster because it leaves the light brigade very short of horses.
sentences.zh: 这其实是一场不小的灾难，因为它导致轻骑兵旅严重缺乏马匹。

sentences.en: And without horses, effectively, you don't have cavalry.
sentences.zh: 没有了马，基本上就没有了骑兵。

sentences.en: But, you know, Cardigan's major general and he's incredibly pleased with himself.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，卡迪根成了少将，他对自己满意极了。

sentences.en: So at least there's that.
sentences.zh: 所以至少还有这一点。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So meanwhile, back at the camps, obviously, they're ravaged by cholera.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，回到营地，显而易见，他们正遭受霍乱的肆虐。

sentences.en: There's also a fire, isn't there, at the beginning of August, which destroys one of their big supply depots.
sentences.zh: 八月初还发生了一场火灾，不是吗？烧毁了他们的大型补给仓库之一。

sentences.en: So you've got 16,000 boots go up in smoke and loads of rations.
sentences.zh: 所以你有1万6千双靴子化为乌烟瘴气，还有大量的口粮。

sentences.en: And actually, interestingly, you mentioned in the first episode, I think it was, how this is often perceived as the first modern war.
sentences.zh: 事实上，有趣的是，我想你曾在第一集里提到过，人们常常认为这是第一场现代战争。

sentences.en: And clearly, lots of things must have gone wrong in the Peninsular War, let's say, or in the Napoleonic Wars.
sentences.zh: 显然，在半岛战争或拿破仑战争中，肯定也出过很多问题。

sentences.en: But, you know, that's a sort of more of a pre-newspaper age, pre-war correspondent age.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，那是一个更偏向于报纸诞生前、战地记者诞生前的时代。

sentences.en: So news of that that isn't disseminated, whereas in this case, you know, everybody's writing the memoirs.
sentences.zh: 所以那类消息没有得到广泛传播，而在这种情况下，你知道，每个人都在写回忆录。

sentences.en: There are war correspondents reporting on the whole thing.
sentences.zh: 有战地记者在全方位报道这件事。

sentences.en: So it's, you know, the sort of the comical blunders of the French and British commanders are being, yeah, being held up, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，法军和英军指挥官那些滑稽的愚蠢失误，正在被，是的，被拿出来……

sentences.en: studded under a microscope, as it were, in a way that they just simply weren't in previous wars.
sentences.zh: 可以说是放在显微镜下审视，这是以往战争中根本没有的。

sentences.en: Well, there's one correspondent in particular, William Howard Russell, and we'll come to him in our next episode, who's there for the Times.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有一位特别的记者，威廉·霍华德·拉塞尔，我们将在下一集里讲到他，他是《泰晤士报》派驻那里的记者。

sentences.en: And he is the kind of the key source for this.
sentences.zh: 他是这方面的主要消息来源。

sentences.en: We'll come to him.
sentences.zh: 我们待会儿会讲到他。

sentences.en: But yes, you're absolutely right that people back in Britain reading their newspapers are being told that things are going badly.
sentences.zh: 但是是的，你说的绝对没错，远在英国国内阅读报纸的人们正被告知事情进展不顺。

sentences.en: And it's very, you know, it's very like the sports pages during a World Cup.
sentences.zh: 这非常，你知道，非常像世界杯期间的体育版面。

sentences.en: England has gone out full of hope, and then they're being told that they've all got, you know, diarrhoea or whatever.
sentences.zh: 英格兰满怀希望地出征，然后他们被告知队员们都得了，你知道，腹泻什么的。

sentences.en: They've got a stroke or, you know, there are too many wags or whatever.
sentences.zh: 他们中风了，或者，你知道，球星家属太多了之类的。

sentences.en: Things are going badly.
sentences.zh: 事情进展很不顺利。

sentences.en: And the manager is reduced to saying, well, you know, our results will do the talking.
sentences.zh: 而主教练只能无奈地说，好吧，你知道，我们的战绩会说明一切。

sentences.en: But the problem for the British military now, and for the fans back home waiting to read about Tales of Daring Do,
sentences.zh: 但现在英国军方以及国内等待阅读英雄传奇故事的球迷们面临的问题是……

sentences.en: is that it looks like the World Cup's been cancelled, that there isn't going to be a war.
sentences.zh: 看起来世界杯好像被取消了，根本不会有什么战争了。

sentences.en: The Russians have withdrawn, so there aren't actually going to be any matches.
sentences.zh: 俄国人撤退了，所以实际上根本不会有任何比赛了。

sentences.en: Yeah, well, this is the thing, right?
sentences.zh: 是啊，就是这样，对吧？

sentences.en: They could stop.
sentences.zh: 他们可以停下来。

sentences.en: They could stop now.
sentences.zh: 他们现在就可以停下来。

sentences.en: They could just go home and say, Constantinople is safe.
sentences.zh: 他们可以直接回家说，君士坦丁堡安全了。

sentences.en: Of course they could, because it's not a sport.
sentences.zh: 他们当然可以，因为这不是一项体育运动。

sentences.en: I mean, that's the whole point.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这才是关键所在。

sentences.en: It's not a World Cup.
sentences.zh: 这不是世界杯。

sentences.en: It's a serious, serious business.
sentences.zh: 这是一件极其严肃的大事。

sentences.en: I mean, don't do it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，别这么干。

sentences.en: Yeah, never do that.
sentences.zh: 对，永远别那样。

sentences.en: But yes, you know, the war aims have been met.
sentences.zh: 但是是的，你知道，战争目标已经达到了。

sentences.en: The Russians have retreated from the Balkans.
sentences.zh: 俄国人已经从巴尔干半岛撤退。

sentences.en: Constantinople is saved.
sentences.zh: 君士坦丁堡保住了。

sentences.en: So that's on the military level.
sentences.zh: 所以在军事层面上就是这样。

sentences.en: I think politically, though, it is really, really difficult.
sentences.zh: 不过我认为在政治层面上，事情真的非常非常棘手。

sentences.en: And a huge part of this is what you were alluding to.
sentences.zh: 其中很大一部分原因正如你刚才所暗示的。

sentences.en: People are reading about this in their newspapers.
sentences.zh: 人们正在报纸上阅读有关这些的消息。

sentences.en: And so they want action.
sentences.zh: 所以他们渴望行动。

sentences.en: And that generates massive pressure on the British government, which in turn generates pressure on the British army.
sentences.zh: 这给英国政府带来了巨大的压力，进而又给英国军队带来了压力。

sentences.en: The British public want stirring tales of derring-do, news of glorious victories.
sentences.zh: 英国公众想要惊心动魄的英勇故事、辉煌胜利的消息。

sentences.en: And neither the British nor the French governments, you know, want to put up with the consequent loss of face.
sentences.zh: 英国政府和法国政府都不想忍受随之而来的颜面尽失。

sentences.en: And even Karl Marx, even Karl Marx is laughing at them back in London.
sentences.zh: 甚至连卡尔·马克思，连卡尔·马克思远在伦敦也都在嘲笑他们。

sentences.en: He's just arrived there.
sentences.zh: 他刚刚抵达那里。

sentences.en: There they are, the French doing nothing, and the British helping them as fast as they can.
sentences.zh: 他们就在那里，法国人什么也不做，英国人则以最快的速度帮他们无所事事。

sentences.en: Great, great repertoire.
sentences.zh: 真是绝妙的讽刺。

sentences.en: So when you've got Karl Marx laughing at you, things are bad.
sentences.zh: 所以当卡尔·马克思都在嘲笑你时，情况就很糟糕了。

sentences.en: So what to do?
sentences.zh: 那该怎么办呢？

sentences.en: So where would you strike?
sentences.zh: 所以你会攻击哪里？

sentences.en: You know, you're there.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你就在那儿。

sentences.en: You're in the Balkans, I suppose.
sentences.zh: 我想你是在巴尔干半岛。

sentences.en: I mean, you could advance through, I don't know, Romania, Bessarabia, you know, into what is now Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你可以通过，我不知道，罗马尼亚、比萨拉比亚，推进到现在的乌克兰。

sentences.en: But land wars aren't really the British thing anyway.
sentences.zh: 但无论如何，陆战其实并不是英国人的强项。

sentences.en: A naval campaign would be the fun thing to do, would it not?
sentences.zh: 海军战役会是一件很有趣的事情，不是吗？

sentences.en: And, of course, you look across the Black Sea, and what do you see?
sentences.zh: 当然，你望向黑海对岸，看到了什么？

sentences.en: You see the main headquarters of the Russian Black Sea fleet.
sentences.zh: 你看到了俄国黑海舰队的主要司令部。

sentences.en: And where is that?
sentences.zh: 那是在哪里？

sentences.en: It's in the Crimea.
sentences.zh: 在克里米亚。

sentences.en: And it is, of course, the mighty port of Sebastopol.
sentences.zh: 当然，那就是强大的港口塞瓦斯托波尔。

sentences.en: And the First Lord of the Admiralty had pointed this out, you know, in December.
sentences.zh: 海军第一大臣在12月的时候就已经指出这一点了。

sentences.en: They'd been working out, you know, should we just focus on the Balkans or should we look further afield?
sentences.zh: 他们一直在研究，你知道，我们是应该把重点放在巴尔干半岛，还是应该把目光投向更远的地方？

sentences.en: And the First Lord of the Admiralty had written, the eye tooth of the bear must be drawn until his fleet and naval arsenal in the Black Sea are destroyed.
sentences.zh: 海军第一大臣曾写道，必须拔掉这只熊最尖锐的牙齿，直到它在黑海的舰队和海军军械库被彻底摧毁。

sentences.en: There is no safety for Constantinople, no security for the peace of Europe.
sentences.zh: 否则君士坦丁堡将永无安全之日，欧洲的和平也将失去保障。

sentences.en: So you make peace by making war.
sentences.zh: 所以要通过发动战争来缔造和平。

sentences.en: This is the principle.
sentences.zh: 这就是原则。

sentences.en: If you knock out Sebastopol, then you knock out the home of the Russian Black Sea fleet, and everything will be brilliant and Constantinople will be secure long term.
sentences.zh: 如果你摧毁了塞瓦斯托波尔，你就摧毁了俄国黑海舰队的大本营，一切都会好起来，君士坦丁堡的长期安全也将得到保障。

sentences.en: And so hawks in the British government, in the popular press, hawks at the breakfast table in, you know, homes across Britain, they're all agitating for an attack on Sebastopol.
sentences.zh: 因此，英国政府中的强硬派、大众媒体中的强硬派、英国各地家庭早餐桌旁的强硬派，都在煽动对塞瓦斯托波尔的进攻。

sentences.en: They want to see it captured.
sentences.zh: 他们希望看到它被攻陷。

sentences.en: They want to see the destruction of Russia's Black Sea fleet.
sentences.zh: 他们希望看到俄国黑海舰队被彻底消灭。

sentences.en: The French, it has to be said, are less convinced.
sentences.zh: 必须承认，法国人的确没有那么坚决。

sentences.en: Saint-Arnaud, you know, he says, well, I mean, I can understand why the British are keen on this, because they're a naval power.
sentences.zh: 圣阿尔诺，你知道的，他说，嗯，我能理解为什么英国人对这个很热心，因为他们是一支海军强国。

sentences.en: What's in it for us?
sentences.zh: 但这对我有什么好处呢？

sentences.en: Well, Napoleon III cares about La Gloire.
sentences.zh: 嗯，拿破仑三世在乎的是荣耀。

sentences.en: He wants to emulate his uncle, doesn't he?
sentences.zh: 他想效仿他的叔叔，不是吗？

sentences.en: He does.
sentences.zh: 他确实想。

sentences.en: And also he wants to maintain the alliance with Britain.
sentences.zh: 而且他还想维持与英国的同盟关系。

sentences.en: He doesn't want to go against Britain.
sentences.zh: 他不想与英国作对。

sentences.en: And actually, by late August, things are so bad in Varna that Saint-Arnaud himself is thinking,
sentences.zh: 事实上，到了8月下旬，瓦尔纳的情况已经糟糕到连圣阿尔诺本人都在考虑……

sentences.en: well, actually, we'd probably lose fewer men if we invade Crimea and attack Sebastopol than if we stay in Varna,
sentences.zh: 嗯，其实如果我们入侵克里米亚并进攻塞瓦斯托波尔，损失的人员可能比我们留在瓦尔纳还要少。

sentences.en: because we've run out of supplies and everyone's dying of cholera and dysentery.
sentences.zh: 因为我们的补给已经耗尽，每个人都在死于霍乱和痢疾。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So it is agreed that the British and French, you know, their war aim now is to attack Sebastopol.
sentences.zh: 所以双方达成一致，英法两国，你知道，他们现在的战争目标就是进攻塞瓦斯托波尔。

sentences.en: I mean, it's a kind of ludicrous war aim.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一个相当荒谬的战争目标。

sentences.en: They've really have just kind of rustled it up.
sentences.zh: 他们其实只是临时拼凑了这么个目标。

sentences.en: You know, they're stuck there twiddling their thumbs otherwise.
sentences.zh: 你知道，否则他们就只能呆在那里无所事事地转动大拇指了。

sentences.en: But on the 24th of August, orders for the embarkation are given.
sentences.zh: 但在8月24日，登船命令下达了。

sentences.en: And on the 7th of September, the Allied flotilla set sail from Varna.
sentences.zh: 在9月7日，盟军舰队从瓦尔纳起航。

sentences.en: And it is a really spectacular sight.
sentences.zh: 那真是一个极其壮观的景象。

sentences.en: Saint-Arnaud's doctor.
sentences.zh: 圣阿尔诺的医生。

sentences.en: Remember, poor Saint-Arnaud has terrible intestinal problems, massive stomach aches.
sentences.zh: 记住，可怜的圣阿尔诺有着严重的肠道问题，胃痛得厉害。

sentences.en: So he has a doctor on hand.
sentences.zh: 所以他身边带着一名医生。

sentences.en: This doctor describes the fleet as looking like a vast industrial city on the waters.
sentences.zh: 这位医生将舰队形容为看起来像水面上的一座巨大工业城市。

sentences.en: And it is led by HMS Agamemnon, which is the Royal Navy's first screw propelled steamship.
sentences.zh: 它由“阿伽门农”号率领，这是皇家海军第一艘螺旋桨驱动的蒸汽船。

sentences.en: So a portent of what is to come in the field of naval technology.
sentences.zh: 因此，这也是海军技术领域未来发展的预兆。

sentences.en: And behind it, there are some 400 ships.
sentences.zh: 在其身后，大约有400艘船只。

sentences.en: There are men of war, transport ships, tugs, all kinds of, you know, the absolute works.
sentences.zh: 有军舰、运输船、拖船，各种各样的，你知道，应有尽有。

sentences.en: And despite the cholera, despite the dysentery, confidence on board is high.
sentences.zh: 尽管有霍乱，尽管有痢疾，船上的信心依然很高。

sentences.en: Morale is good.
sentences.zh: 士气很好。

sentences.en: There is excitement.
sentences.zh: 大家都很兴奋。

sentences.en: There is anticipation.
sentences.zh: 大家都在热切期盼。

sentences.en: But the big question is, is this sense of excitement and anticipation justified?
sentences.zh: 但最大的问题是，这种兴奋感和期待感是正当的吗？

sentences.en: Because as we've said, the decision to attack Sebastopol is above all a political one.
sentences.zh: 因为正如我们所说，进攻塞瓦斯托波尔的决定首先是一个政治决定。

sentences.en: And the view of the Crimea that you have in London is not necessarily the one that the Black Sea affords.
sentences.zh: 你在伦敦所看到的克里米亚，未必就是黑海展现给你的那个样子。

sentences.en: And in our next episode, we will see how the invasion goes and whether the confidence of the British and the French in their military capabilities is justified.
sentences.zh: 在下一集中，我们将看到入侵进展如何，以及英法两国对自身军事能力的信心是否合理。

sentences.en: So next time, the Allies will have their first taste of battle.
sentences.zh: 所以下一次，盟军将迎来他们的初次交锋。

sentences.en: There will be glorious feats of arms and there will be ludicrous and spectacular blunders.
sentences.zh: 那里会有辉煌的战功，也会有荒谬而壮观的重大失误。

sentences.en: And the feud between Lord Lucan and Lord Cardigan will reach a highly entertaining new level of intensity.
sentences.zh: 卢卡恩勋爵和卡迪根勋爵之间的宿怨将达到一个极其引人入胜的全新白热化程度。

sentences.en: Now, if you remember, the rest is history club.
sentences.zh: 现在，如果你还记得的话，“历史其余部分”俱乐部。

sentences.en: Of our very own well-dressed Light Brigade.
sentences.zh: 我们自己衣着光鲜的轻骑兵旅。

sentences.en: Then you can hear that and the final episode galloping into the jaws of death.
sentences.zh: 那么你可以收听那一集以及最后一集《冲向死亡之口》。

sentences.en: You can hear those right now.
sentences.zh: 你现在就可以收听这些内容。

sentences.en: If you are not a club member, you might want to listen to them.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是俱乐部会员，你可能会想去听听。

sentences.en: So you can just go to the rest is history dot com and sign up.
sentences.zh: 所以你只需访问“the rest is history dot com”并注册即可。

sentences.en: Now, don't just sign up for yourself because Christmas is coming.
sentences.zh: 现在，不要只给自己注册，因为圣诞节快到了。

sentences.en: And there is no better gift for the loved ones in your life than rest is history club membership.
sentences.zh: 对于你生命中所爱的人来说，没有比“历史其余部分”俱乐部会员资格更好的礼物了。

sentences.en: And to remind you, that would be a whole year for your loved ones of ad free listening.
sentences.zh: 提醒你一下，你的至爱将享有一整年免受广告打扰的收听体验。

sentences.en: They'd get bonus episodes.
sentences.zh: 他们将获得独家放送的额外剧集。

sentences.en: They'd get access to full series without waiting weeks and weeks and weeks.
sentences.zh: 他们将能够观看完整系列，而无需苦等数周又数周。

sentences.en: They'd get a newsletter.
sentences.zh: 他们会收到一份电子通讯。

sentences.en: They'd get all kinds of treats.
sentences.zh: 他们会收到各种各样的礼物。

sentences.en: It would be the best Christmas ever.
sentences.zh: 这将是有史以来最棒的圣诞节。

sentences.en: And our producer, Callum,
sentences.zh: 我们的制作人卡勒姆特意交代过我，

sentences.en: would not forgive me if I didn't tell you that the way to find these gifts is to go to the rest is history dot com website and to click where it says gifts.
sentences.zh: 如果我不告诉你去 the rest is history 点 com 网站并点击“礼物”栏目就能找到这些礼物，他是绝对不会原谅我的。

sentences.en: Because Callum knows that you would be incapable of doing that were he not to offer you this important advice.
sentences.zh: 因为卡勒姆深知，如果没有他给你这个重要的建议，你是绝对想不出该怎么做的。

sentences.en: So go to gifts at the website and you'll be able to get these tremendous gifts for the loved ones in your life.
sentences.zh: 所以，快去网站的礼品区看看吧，你将能为生活中的挚爱挑选到这些极棒的礼物。

sentences.en: And on that exciting bombshell, I say goodbye and we will see you.
sentences.zh: 带着这个令人兴奋的重磅消息，我要说再见了，我们回头见。

sentences.en: If you remember the club, we'll see you just a few minutes and we will be advancing on Sebastopol and it will be absolutely brilliant.
sentences.zh: 如果你还记得这个俱乐部，我们几分钟后就会见，我们将向塞瓦斯托波尔推进，那绝对会非常精彩。

sentences.en: Goodbye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Bye bye.
sentences.zh: 拜拜。
